value.text: The Cormac McCarthy Journal is an online, peer-reviewed journal focusing on the works and influence of Cormac McCarthy. The CMJ publishes articles, notes, and reviews related to Cormac McCarthy’s novels, film adaptations, and scholarly works. The CMJ is published biannually online and annually each fall. CMJ is supported by the Cormac McCarthy Society (www.cormacmccarthy.com) and is a member of the Council of Editors of Learned Journals.
CMJ is affiliated with The Cormac McCarthy Society, which was founded in 1995 by Rick Wallach.
